findings.title: Scenario C: bad debt 'without beacon' is 0 by construction
findings.problem: Bad debt = debt - value(ghost + m - Position.suspect). With useBeacon=false p.suspect is always 0 and debt <= value*ltv, so bad debt is always 0; with the beacon, borrow is refused (debt 0). Headline figure is 0 vs 0, 'with <= without' is vacuous, and 'burned at market == sum suspect' fails for the beacon-less market.
findings.fix: Measure from Ghost-side truth, independent of market config: attacker sole depositor (asserted); burnedAtMarket = balance delta around _destroy; recoverableUsdc = ghost.balanceOf(market)/1e12; badDebt = max(0, debt - recoverableUsdc). Assert burnedAtMarket == suspect entering the market as measured by the test (effectiveSuspectOf delta or GhostTransferred.suspectMoved) for both markets; p.suspect equality only for useBeacon=true.

findings.title: MockLendingMarket divides by zero for M-only positions
findings.problem: p.ghost == 0 (M-only position, the case highlighted by constat 4) makes borrow/haircutBps/collateralValue panic 0x12, and withdrawing only the M leg panics in Math.ceilDiv(0,0).
findings.fix: ratioPos = p.ghost == 0 ? 0 : p.suspect*1e18/p.ghost; in withdraw only reduce suspect if ghostAmt > 0, capped by p.suspect. Test: M-only deposit -> borrow within LTV ok, haircutBps == base, M-leg withdraw after unlockAt ok.

findings.title: Divergences with data/ghost_ledger.py (#25, PR #82) not listed
findings.where: whole design (no mention of data/ghost_ledger.py or data/scenarios_cd.py)
findings.problem: The off-chain reference ledger used by scenarios C/D differs on: conversion (all matured, suspicion leaves with it vs partial lock, suspicion never converts), suspicion model (single permanent float vs Sc/Sp with expiry + Clear), delay (free until + lift_delay vs incident-bound, capped, monotone, no lift), destruction (pro-rata tranches vs Sc from newest), rounding (float vs ceilDiv), unbacked mint/deficit, fees, units (6 vs 18 decimals in thresholds), market (one vault per loan vs one mixed address), pool price (0.9 vs fixed fixture), restitution/insurance/pause absent.
findings.fix: Add a section 'Ecarts avec data/ghost_ledger.py' with the table (who aligns: data/), copy it to the PR description and notify the data/ owner; do not modify data/. State which side is faithful to OPEN_ANSWERS for conversion-of-suspicion and lift_delay (the design). Optional test_ledgerParity_simpleChain with hard-coded expected values.

findings.title: Monitor compatibility: meaning of Transfer logs and mint requestId unspecified
findings.problem: Listener treats every Transfer(0x0,to) as a mint with UNKNOWN_REQUEST_ID (= 0) and drops to==0x0. With the design, M never emits Transfer(from,to) (transfer = Transfer(from,0x0)), every Transfer(0x0,a) on M is a conversion, and Transfer(0x0,to) on M-Ghost covers mint / M transfer / restitution. The requestId-bearing event (SwapCompleted) is on ProtectedMinter, GhostIssued lacks requestId, and request id 0 exists (nextRequestId starts at 0) colliding with the sentinel.
findings.fix: Add indexed requestId to GhostIssued (issueFromMinter(to, amount, requestId)), resolve the id-0 collision (start nextRequestId at 1 or explicit flag), name SwapCompleted as the reference mint event for the dedicated decoder, add a per-address 'monitor reading' table in §3.12 (M-Ghost Transfer(0,to)+GhostIssued(kind); Ghost transfers is_ghost=true; conversions/destructions; M transfers rebuilt from GhostIssued(TRANSFER_M).source; M Transfer(0,a) = conversion never mint), copy to PR for #9/#10, and test_events_monitorMapping with vm.expectEmit.
